world: Paint one image containing nine equal landscape panels, three across and three down, read left to right, with plain narrow gutters and no drawn text, labels, numbers or arrows. Every panel shares heavy rain, grey dawn skylight from the canal side, faint amber at the horizon, subdued greens, earthy reds and browns, deep shaded areas and small wet highlights. Use the supplied face references without their smiling expressions. Aruni has warm medium-brown skin, broad cheekbones, steady dark eyes and centre-parted black hair secured in a soaked low bun; she wears the white collared, short-sleeved nurse's dress, white waist belt, white closed shoes and small silver studs. Nimal has a broad face, thick brows, neat black moustache and flattened short wavy hair; he wears the soaked rust-brown shirt with sleeves rolled to his forearms, dark brown trousers, black belt and dark sandals. He lies still with eyes closed. Aruni retains the small navy medical bag with black handles in her left hand throughout. Match the separate references for the black smartphone and small metal key. Keep the key concealed before panel five and the phone concealed before panel seven. Represent object markings only as indistinct surface texture, never readable characters.
geography: The route follows one muddy red-earth bank from the paddy-field approach at screen left to a widened bank-side apron beside the sluice at screen right. Short green rice rows and flooded plots border the approach; wet grass separates the path from opaque brown canal water. At the apron, stained concrete encloses the rust-brown gate and its vertical lifting spindle, with the channel receding beyond it. Nimal lies along the near-bank slope, head on the raised bank at screen right and feet toward the water at screen left; his right fist rests beside his torso on the accessible bank side. Aruni approaches left to right and later kneels beside that hand. All cameras remain on this same landward bank side. A projecting section of gate metal can enter the foreground from the low apron setup without putting the camera across the canal. The field approach looks along the route; gate views look into the concrete throat and adjoining water rather than repeating the location plate.

panels.camera: Bank-side rear three-quarter view, looking diagonally along Aruni's route toward screen right; wide, 35mm feel, deep focus. Aruni occupies about one quarter of the panel.
panels.background: Waterlogged green paddy fills the left distance, with red-brown bunds and a low amber-grey horizon. The muddy path angles toward the right edge beside wet canal grass; the gate apron and Nimal remain beyond the right crop.
panels.picture: Aruni is upright in a walking stride in the left third, seen mainly from behind with her body and face directed screen right. Her navy medical bag hangs from her left hand, and her empty right hand is visible beside her wet white dress. Rain streaks cross the open field and collect in the path's shallow puddles.

panels.camera: Eye-level view from the landward bank, looking obliquely toward the gate; wide, 40mm feel, both people and the structure readable. Preserve left-to-right approach direction.
panels.background: The stained concrete throat and rust-brown gate stand behind Nimal on the right, with the spindle above. Brown channel water and wet grass recede toward the upper left, while the muddy approach enters at lower left.
panels.picture: Aruni stands in the left third facing screen right, her gaze fixed downward toward Nimal, bag hanging from her left hand and right hand empty. Nimal lies across the lower right with his head at screen right, feet toward the water at screen left and eyes closed. His closed right fist rests beside his torso, with its contents completely hidden by his fingers.

panels.camera: Eye level with standing Aruni, still on the landward side; close-up, 85mm feel, shallow focus. Her face fills the panel left of centre, with looking room down and right.
panels.background: The gate becomes a soft dark vertical area at frame right. Rain-dimpled brown water and a narrow trace of green grass dissolve into softer tones at frame left.
panels.picture: Aruni's rain-wet face fills the panel, turned down and screen right. Her lips are closed, her brows held steady and her eyes lowered with restrained concentration. Her centre part, slick hair and low bun remain consistent with the approach view.

panels.zone: canal gate — low apron beside projecting gate metal
panels.camera: Low bank-side three-quarter view, 50mm feel, medium depth of field. Frame the opening two-shot tall enough to retain upright Aruni at left and Nimal's face and upper torso low at right.
panels.background: Wet concrete ledges and the gate's dark steel surface occupy the right background; brown water and grass occupy the left. A soft projecting gate bar crosses the lower centre in front of Nimal's hand position.
panels.picture: Aruni is still upright at frame left, facing screen right and looking down at Nimal, with the navy bag in her left hand and her right hand empty. Nimal's face and rust-brown upper torso lie low at frame right, his eyes closed and head pointing right. The foreground bar completely covers his right fist and the space immediately around it.

panels.camera: Downward bank-side macro insert, 100mm feel, with the knuckles and exposed key head sharply defined. Maintain the established orientation, with his forearm entering from screen right.
panels.background: Soft wet red-brown earth fills the lower and left edges. A small dark concrete edge falls out of focus at upper right; no faces or other hands enter.
panels.picture: Nimal's closed right fist fills the panel diagonally, with his bare wrist entering from screen right and a little rolled rust-brown sleeve fabric at the far edge. The small metal key remains enclosed by his curled fingers, its rounded rectangular head and circular hole projecting clearly at the centre. Rain beads catch on the metal, while the engraved area is suggested only by shallow texture without drawn characters.

panels.camera: Eye level with kneeling Aruni from the landward side; close-up, 85mm feel, shallow focus. Her face sits left of centre with dark looking room down and screen right.
panels.background: Low stained concrete forms a soft dark area at frame right. Brown water and reflected grey dawn make muted blur at frame left, with a narrow green edge near the top.
panels.picture: Aruni's face fills the panel at her kneeling height, angled down and screen right. Her lips are closed, and rain runs from her flattened hairline along her cheeks. Her expression remains contained, with no phone or hands inside the crop.

panels.camera: Downward insert over Aruni's right forearm from the bank side; 75mm feel, medium depth of field. The phone and right hand fill the centre, with her left hand and bag at the far left edge.
panels.background: Wet white dress fabric lies behind the phone at lower right. Muddy red earth recedes softly across the upper edge, and the navy bag forms a narrow dark block at frame left.
panels.picture: Aruni's right hand holds the black smartphone above her right thigh, its glass screen facing the camera and her thumb resting clear of the call control. The screen shows a simple contact silhouette and an unlabelled circular control, without letters or numerals. At the far left, her left hand still grips the black handles of the navy medical bag beside her knee.

panels.camera: Match panel six: eye level with kneeling Aruni on the same bank side, close-up, 85mm feel and shallow focus. Keep her face left of centre and her gaze down toward screen right.
panels.background: Match the earlier kneeling close-up: blurred low concrete at frame right, soft brown water at frame left and a thin green trace near the top. Keep the same rain density and grey highlights.
panels.picture: Aruni remains kneeling, her rain-wet face filling the panel and her gaze lowered screen right. Her lips are closed and her expression is tightly contained. Only her head, neck and white collar enter the frame.

panels.camera: Return to panel two's landward-bank camera position and direction; eye-level wide, 40mm feel, deep focus. Preserve Nimal's head-right, feet-left orientation.
panels.background: The same stained concrete throat, rust-brown gate and spindle occupy the right background. Brown water and wet grass recede toward the upper left, with the muddy approach returning at lower left.
panels.picture: Aruni now kneels at the left side of Nimal's right hand, facing down and screen right. She holds the phone low above her right thigh in her right hand and retains the navy medical bag beside her left knee in her left hand. Nimal lies still across the lower right, eyes closed, head at screen right and feet toward the water at screen left; his fist remains closed around the key, reduced at this distance to a small metal glint.

conflicts: Several shot notes place the phone in a right trouser pocket, but Aruni's approved outfit is a white uniform dress. Retain the dress and keep phone storage outside the frame.
Shot five specifies a sand-coloured cuff, while Nimal's look and reference show a rust-brown shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms. Use the bare wrist and rolled rust-brown sleeve edge.
Aruni's look sheet includes a white medical bag, but the dedicated medical-bag reference and prop description specify navy with black handles. Use the dedicated navy prop consistently.
The key insert and phone insert request readable markings or a contact name. The no-text rule takes precedence: suggest the key's engraved area as texture and use only unlabelled phone graphics.
Shot four's framing note describes Aruni after kneeling, while its explicit opening picture places her upright. The panel follows the upright opening and retains both faces within the composition.
Shot six references an appeal labelled L4, but no wording is supplied. Its opening panel follows the specified closed-lip expression without inventing dialogue.
The supplied axis description ends mid-sentence. Use its complete bank-side and screen-direction instructions, with bag continuity taken from the repeated shot specifications.
